mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% over the next 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a weakening demand environment, triggering negative earnings outlook and driving S&P 500 forward returns down over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS falls >0.5% and UNRATE rises >0.2pp over prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, housing starts below 500,000 units signal real estate sector weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansions when HOUST < 500.0 units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production decline below 90.0 indicates manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 90.0 over the next 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL increase above 0.5 index points from prior month signals rising inflation, prompting Fed tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises >0.5 index points over the next 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates inflationary demand slowdown, triggering Fed policy response that reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS falls >0.5% and CPIAUCSL rises >0.5 index points over prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals unexpected labor market slowdown, reducing consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%) when PAYEMS declines >0.5% from prior month.
